resources.string: A Mixel technician can see your screen and help you. Ask the technician for a support code and type it here.
Ready. Tell the technician this number:
A Mixel team member (Remote ID %1$s) wants to see your screen.
Someone from your company (Remote ID %1$s) wants to see your screen.
They will also be able to tap and type on this phone.
They can only look; they cannot operate this phone.
This support code is not valid or has expired.
That did not work. Please try again.
Let the technician operate this phone
Off. The technician can only look. To allow tapping and typing, switch on “Mixel Quick Support” under Accessibility.
On. During a session the technician can tap and type. You can switch this off at any time under Accessibility.
Lets a Mixel technician tap, swipe and type on this phone during a support session that you allowed. It is used only while such a session runs and reads no screen content.
Your screen is being shared with a Mixel technician.
The session is encrypted. It ends when you or the technician end it; the registration of this phone is removed automatically afterwards.
